# Flight events

`orhelper.FlightEvent` has one member for each kind of event OpenRocket records during a flight.
[`Helper.get_events`][orhelper.Helper.get_events] returns a dictionary that maps each event that occurred
to the list of times (in seconds) at which it did.

| Member | Name in OpenRocket | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| `LAUNCH` | Launch | all |
| `IGNITION` | Motor ignition | all |
| `LIFTOFF` | Lift-off | all |
| `LAUNCHROD` | Launch rod clearance | all |
| `BURNOUT` | Motor burnout | all |
| `EJECTION_CHARGE` | Ejection charge | all |
| `STAGE_SEPARATION` | Stage separation | all |
| `APOGEE` | Apogee | all |
| `RECOVERY_DEVICE_DEPLOYMENT` | Recovery device deployment | all |
| `GROUND_HIT` | Ground hit | all |
| `SIMULATION_END` | Simulation end | all |
| `ALTITUDE` | Altitude change | all |
| `TUMBLE` | Tumbling | all |
| `EXCEPTION` | Exception | all |
| `SIM_WARN` | Warning | 24.12, 26.xx |
| `SIM_ABORT` | Simulation abort | 24.12, 26.xx |
